Class PriceCandle

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.marketdata.history.PriceCandle
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.data.domain.Persistable<PriceCandle.Key>
@Entity public class PriceCandle extends Object implements org.springframework.data.domain.Persistable<PriceCandle.Key>
Represents one OHLC candle aggregated from the live simulation tick stream for an instrument, over a fixed-width time bucket.

Identified by its natural key - instrument, width and bucket start - rather than a surrogate id. The key is assigned, not generated, so the entity reports whether it is new itself: otherwise Spring Data's saveAll would treat every candle as possibly existing and merge it, issuing a SELECT per row and giving up the batched inserts the backfill and the accumulator's flush depend on. Candles are only ever inserted, never updated.
